text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Inari One surges forward with momentum!
Inari One pulling ahead! Inari One pulls ahead!!
And crosses the finish line!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Inariiii!!! You were amazing!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Inari-chaaaan!!!
Congratulations, reallyyyyy!!!!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
Look at you, all grown up and dignified.

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that...
my eyes are so bleary I can't help it――

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It's so hot...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It felt like a direct blow to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes. It was a race that... really moved the heart, wasn't it?♪
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I did it――

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I did it…… I did it, I did it……!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oooooooohh!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I won!!
I'm standing at the very top of the regional circuit!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Boss!
Did you burn that into your memory!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Sis!
Did you burn that into your memory!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"We took it...!
The very 'top' right here at Ohi!!"

(Inari! Inari! Inari! Inari!
Inari! Inari! Inari! Inari!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Thanks for the cheers!
Allow me, the humble Inari One, to take this opportunity
to make a declaration!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
In the upcoming Senior Class...
I'm taking the "top" spot in the JRA too!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"My goal is countless victories in the JRA GⅠs!
And then—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely going to become next year's Umamusume of the Year!!
(Ooooohhh!!!)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Umamusume of the Year...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪
As expected of Inari-chan...
Aiming high, aren't we~?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Inari has noticed us.
Which means this is—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes. It is also a message to us.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I won't lose, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"—I'm astonished. Today's run aside,
to think Oguri Cap and the others are
that intensely aware of Inari One...!"

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
And the sheer fervor of this crowd...!
Her earlier declaration to become Horse Girl of the Year...!
Could Inari One perhaps be—

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text: ...With Tamamo Cross stepping down from the front lines, I thought the era would stagnate... but now it's anyone's guess...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Boss.
What's the next race I'm headin' for?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Sis.
What race am I heading for next?
Caught off guard by the sudden question, but the races I wanted to take on with Inari One during the Senior year had already long been decided...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heheh, isn't this freaking awesome...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Next year, our first target is the Tenno Sho (Spring)!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Starting with this, I'm gonna set off huge fireworks
one after another and turn the JRA into
an unprecedented, blowout festival!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Everyone—don't you dare miss out on this festival!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well now, since you declared it in front of everyone,
there's no running away now, partner!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit!
Now that's my stylish Trainer for ya!!
And so, Inari One and I burned the scenery from the regional "top" into our memories—

She charged straight toward the next festive stage—
the Senior-class JRA GⅠ brawl on the turf!!
